hypotheses.statement: Extreme cross-sectional return dispersion weakens the subsequent cross-sectional crypto momentum spread.
hypotheses.evidence_note: The primary estimate was positive; the later follow-up discovery effect did not replicate in validation/final splits. DISPERSION-003 full grid (216 cells) on expanding universe (32 cap+Binance assets): all cells OK, 0 Holm-rejected. Anchor H004V106 development high_low_diff_net_1x = -0.0599 (not Holm-significant). Sealed forward block 2025-01-01 to 2026-09-29: 637 formations, high_low_diff_net_1x = -0.0097, same negative sign but small magnitude; not an economically meaningful edge.
hypotheses.evidence_note_correction_20261025: CORRECTION: the 637-formation / -0.0097 figure quoted above was sourced from the DEFECTIVE archived block (archive_defective_momentum_20261024), which used price-level momentum (dispersion ~1e149), had no block_sealing_rule, and ran formations through 2026-09-29 on a 2026-10-23 cutoff with look-ahead risk. It is quarantined, not canonical. The canonical sealed forward block (forward_block/forward_block_evaluation.json, H004V106, cutoff 2026-09-30, last formation 2026-08-31) has 608 formations and high_low_diff_net_1x = +0.6165 (POSITIVE sign, opposite to H1's registered negative prediction); Newey-West HAC with lag 29 gives t~1.55, 95% CI [-0.164, 1.397], i.e. NOT statistically significant. The canonical block is development/exploratory evidence only and is NOT independent confirmation. H1 remains NOT_SUPPORTED_AS_ROBUST_EDGE; the sign disagreement between canonical (+0.617) and the defective block (-0.0097) is itself a stability warning. See H7.

hypotheses.statement: Extreme dispersion may strengthen cross-sectional momentum continuation in some regimes.
hypotheses.evidence_note: Generated from the sign of the primary estimate; the existing chronological follow-up did not establish replication.
hypotheses.next_test: Test on a fresh forward block; do not retroactively relabel H1.

hypotheses.statement: The dispersion-momentum relationship may depend on historical market-cap rank breadth and asset cohort.
hypotheses.evidence_note: Rank-frontier diagnostics change sign across observed cutoffs; this is a stability warning, not proof of a usable interaction.
hypotheses.next_test: Expand lower historical rank cohorts without a top-N cutoff and report fixed rank bands with adequate sample sizes.

hypotheses.statement: A continuous dispersion predictor may contain more information than sparse high/low state labels.
hypotheses.evidence_note: High/low state counts are sparse in existing folds.
hypotheses.next_test: Predefine a continuous slope/interaction model and inference method before computing outcomes.

hypotheses.statement: The apparent state-dependent spread may be driven by outliers, portfolio-tail construction or asset-volatility exposure.
hypotheses.evidence_note: Current sample is small and universe-cutoff sensitivity is material.
hypotheses.next_test: Pre-register outlier-robust and risk-normalized diagnostics as a separate family with multiplicity control.

hypotheses.statement: The negative high-minus-low dispersion-momentum spread persists on sealed forward data but at a magnitude too small to be an economically meaningful edge after costs.
hypotheses.evidence_note: DISPERSION-003 canonical sealed forward block (H004V106, forward_block/forward_block_evaluation.json, data_cutoff 2026-09-30, last_allowed_formation 2026-08-31, 608 completed 30-day formations): high_low_diff_net_1x = +0.6165, POSITIVE sign, opposite to H1's registered negative prediction. Newey-West HAC (lag 29, Bartlett) on the weighted high/low contrast gives t~1.55, 95% CI [-0.164, 1.397] - NOT statistically significant at 95%, and the CI spans zero. Median spread is near zero (-0.0106). The positive mean is driven by a minority of high-state formations (n_high=61 vs n_low=90); overlap-aware uncertainty materially widens the interval. NOTE: an earlier registry note quoted 637 formations and -0.0097 from the defective archived block; that figure is superseded by the canonical block above. Requires confirmation on a genuinely fresh sealed forward block (after 2026-09-29) with a predeclared economic significance threshold and Holm-significance across the cell family.
hypotheses.next_test: Evaluate H004V106 anchor on the next sealed forward block after 2026-09-29; require |high_low_diff_net_1x| above a predeclared economic significance threshold and Holm-significance across the cell family.

hypotheses.statement: The canonical H004V106 sealed forward block shows a POSITIVE high-minus-low dispersion-momentum spread (+0.617 net 1x) that is not statistically significant under overlap-aware HAC inference.
hypotheses.evidence_note: Canonical sealed forward block: 608 formations (2025-01-01..2026-08-31), high_low_diff_net_1x = +0.6165, spread_net_1x_mean = +0.0996, median -0.0106, n_high=61, n_low=90, n_mid=457. HAC t~1.55, CI [-0.164, 1.397]. This is development/exploratory evidence: the block is a strict subset of the grid ledger's development window (2023-01-31..2026-09-29) and was already inspected, so it cannot serve as independent confirmation. The positive sign contradicts H1's registered negative prediction and contradicts the defective archived block's -0.0097; the discrepancy between the two blocks is a stability red flag, not a resolved finding.
hypotheses.next_test: Preregister H7 as a positive-direction candidate only after a fresh, mature sealed forward block (formations after 2026-09-29) is available; compute HAC/overlap-aware uncertainty on completed 30-day outcomes only. Until then H7 is EXPLORATORY_ONLY.
hypotheses.evidence_note_addendum_20261025T19Z: STATE-REPRESENTATIVENESS AUDIT (DISP-003-STATEAUDIT-001, preregistered 2026-10-25T07:45Z, artifact integrity_audit/H004V106_state_representativeness_audit_20261025.json): the +0.617 estimate is CLUSTER_DOMINATED. Leave-one-out by calendar month: dropping 2025-10 moves high_low_diff_net_1x from +0.617 to +0.093 (delta fraction -0.849, far beyond the predeclared 50% threshold); dropping 2025-07 moves it to +0.847 (+0.373). The largest high-state cluster is 2025-10 with 31 of 61 high formations; high states are observed in only 7 calendar months (2025-04:1, 2025-07:18, 2025-08:1, 2025-09:2, 2025-10:31, 2025-11:8, none in 2025-12..2026-08). The positive mean is therefore not a stable property of the dispersion-momentum mechanism across the block; it is concentrated in one month. This is a measurement-feasibility diagnostic on already-inspected development evidence, NOT a fresh holdout and NOT independent confirmation. It further weakens any inclination to treat +0.617 as a reliable positive-direction signal.

hypotheses.statement: The canonical H004V106 positive high-minus-low estimate (+0.617) is dominated by a single calendar-month cluster (2025-10) rather than being representative across the forward block.
hypotheses.evidence_note: DISP-003-STATEAUDIT-001, preregistered before computation (preregistrations/H004V106_STATE_REPRESENTATIVENESS_AUDIT_v1.md), executed 2026-10-25T19Z. Decision rule predeclared: if removing any single calendar month moves high_low_diff_net_1x by >50% of full-block magnitude, or the largest single-month high-state cluster contributes >50% of the high-state mean, label CLUSTER_DOMINATED. Result: CLUSTER_DOMINATED on both criteria. Baseline high_low_diff_net_1x = +0.6165 (608 formations, n_high=61, n_low=90). Dropping 2025-10 -> +0.0933 (delta frac -0.849). Largest high-state month 2025-10: 31/61 high formations, mean +1.046, share of high-state mean 1.94 (the high-state mean is itself negative once 2025-10 is removed, since the remaining 30 high formations average below the low-state mean). High states occur in only 7 of 24 calendar months in the block and none after 2025-11. No frozen artifact was modified; the canonical block is read-only. This is exploratory diagnostic evidence only; it cannot validate or refute H1/H6/H7 and does not unlock the confirmatory track.
hypotheses.next_test: If the mechanism is cluster-driven, test whether it survives (a) a rolling/adaptive shorter dispersion reference window and (b) conditioning on the 2025-10 dispersion regime, each under a NEW preregistered experiment ID on development data only. A genuinely fresh sealed forward block (formations after 2026-09-29) remains required for any confirmatory claim.

Formation-month cluster bootstrap on the canonical H004V106 forward block (608 formations, 20 calendar months, n_boot=1999, rng_seed 20261029): baseline high_low_diff_net_1x = +0.6165223953929937, bootstrap mean 0.5239, bootstrap median 0.5735, bootstrap SE 0.3746, 95% percentile CI [-0.1179, 1.1431], ci_includes_zero = true.
